input.summary: Remove the de facto exclusivity / right-of-first-refusal gate in Section 7.2 on Customer engaging another provider.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a right of first refusal that requires us to disclose and match a competing offer before we may engage another provider; our playbook position is that we retain full freedom to source from other suppliers, and this also conflicts with Section 12.3. If some form of restriction is essential, we could look at exclusivity limited to a single defined service category for no more than twelve months, ending automatically if Vendor misses a service level or delivery date.

ops.oldText: 7.2 Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: 7.2 Customer may engage any other provider at any time and is not required to notify Vendor of, disclose, or match any competing or more favourable commercial offer it receives as a condition of doing so.
